# Mike Vallotton

> Practical guidance from CTO Mike Vallotton about understanding artificial intelligence, applying it at work, building reliable AI systems, and preserving human judgment.

Canonical site: https://mikevallotton.com
Author: Mike Vallotton, Chief Technology Officer at Sagepath Reply
Language: English

## Topics

- [AI Fundamentals](https://mikevallotton.com/ai-fundamentals): How large language models work, how context and iteration affect results, and how to use AI responsibly.
- [AI and Work](https://mikevallotton.com/ai-and-work): How AI changes workflows, careers, organizations, leadership, and professional skills.
- [AI Agents](https://mikevallotton.com/ai-agents): What agents are, how they use tools and workflows, where they create value, and why oversight matters.
- [AI Search and GEO](https://mikevallotton.com/ai-search-and-geo): How AI search changes discovery and what makes information understandable and retrievable.
- [Software Development and AI](https://mikevallotton.com/software-development-and-ai): How AI changes engineering workflows, developer roles, leadership, and technical judgment.
- [AI and Thinking](https://mikevallotton.com/ai-and-thinking): How AI affects reasoning, learning, trust, judgment, and critical thinking.

## About

- [About Mike Vallotton](https://mikevallotton.com/about): Mike's progression since 1996 through software engineering, architecture, enterprise digital experience, technology leadership, and applied AI.

## Operating Principles

- [Clarity Before Tools](https://mikevallotton.com/clarity-before-tools): Define the goal, audience, constraints, context, and standard of success before deciding how AI should help.
- [Judgment Over Generation](https://mikevallotton.com/judgment-over-generation): Use AI to expand options and accelerate execution while keeping people responsible for tradeoffs and consequences.
- [Bottlenecks Over Use Cases](https://mikevallotton.com/bottlenecks-over-use-cases): Find useful applications for AI by starting with delays, confusion, handoffs, and repeated rework.
- [Quality Over Speed](https://mikevallotton.com/quality-over-speed): Pair AI acceleration with clear standards, deliberate iteration, verification, and review.
- [Systems That Hold Up](https://mikevallotton.com/systems-that-hold-up): Design reliable AI workflows around sound information, ownership, constrained authority, evaluation, and feedback.

## Articles

- [How I Would Use AI If I Was Looking for a Job](https://mikevallotton.com/articles/ai-job-search): The five prompts I would use to understand what you can offer, find sourced employers, research fit, identify real overlap, and decide what to do next. The page includes a five-part related video series.
  - [Experienced Professional Example](https://mikevallotton.com/articles/ai-job-search/examples/experienced-professional): Synthetic input and output for a senior B2B SaaS operations leader researching ServiceNow.
  - [Early-Career Candidate Example](https://mikevallotton.com/articles/ai-job-search/examples/early-career): Synthetic input and output for an IT support specialist exploring security compliance and customer trust paths.
  - [Career Changer Example](https://mikevallotton.com/articles/ai-job-search/examples/career-changer-weak-match): Synthetic input and output for a Spanish teacher evaluating a narrow, weak immediate fit with Duolingo.
  - [Broad Generalist Example](https://mikevallotton.com/articles/ai-job-search/examples/broad-generalist): Synthetic input and output for a startup generalist narrowing broad experience into specific lanes.
  - [Local Small-Employer Example](https://mikevallotton.com/articles/ai-job-search/examples/local-small-employer): Synthetic input and output for a local candidate exploring a small bookstore and community business.
- [News Investigator Agent](https://mikevallotton.com/articles/news-investigator): Use the News Investigator Agent to compare reporting, evaluate evidence, identify uncertainty, and strengthen your judgment.
- [What an Agentic SOC Teaches Us About Enterprise AI](https://mikevallotton.com/articles/agentic-soc-enterprise-ai): A field note from the Agentic SOC Forum on process design, orchestration, bounded autonomy, auditability, governance, and human accountability.
